g.text: Brake routing: moving guides turn relative attitude into brake pull
Kinematic sketch, not to scale. P/G move with payload; A/C move with canopy; D follows the riser.
S–G constant; G–D and D–C vary.
Inputs and calculation at each RK4 stage
Payload + canopy pose → P, G, A, C → riser direction D
Current path length − fixed rigging reference = ΔL
Effective pull = max(0, servo pull − slack + ΔL)
Five canopy panels → forces / moments → next pose
132 → 185 mm riser span; guide span stays 91 mm.
Ring distance 20–80 mm: sensitivity assumption, not a photo measurement.
No line elasticity, ring friction, fabric deformation, contact migration or independent riser dynamics.
